sentences.zh: 你觉得离家工作怎么样？
你喜欢这种到处奔波的生活吗？

sentences.zh: 我妻子很喜欢，你知道，因为她能把我打发走几个月。

sentences.en: Like, Malta seems like a good spot.
sentences.zh: 马耳他看起来是个不错的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, she's here now, to be fair.
sentences.zh: 说实话，她现在就在这儿。

sentences.zh: 前四周我是一个人在这儿的，你知道。

sentences.zh: 而且，我们在老家还有一位94岁的母亲，需要人照顾，

sentences.zh: 她没法旅行，所以家里有很多琐事要处理。

sentences.en: But thank God we've got a big enough family, we can kind of get on with that, you know.
sentences.zh: 但谢天谢地，我们家人口够多，能把这些事安排好，你知道。

sentences.en: But I've always travelled with a family.
sentences.zh: 不过我一直都是带着家人一起旅行的。

sentences.en: You know, when the kids were younger, if I was working in the States or I was working
sentences.zh: 你知道，孩子们小的时候，如果我在美国工作或者在

sentences.en: in Europe, you'd take the kids with you, and it's the greatest education in the world
sentences.zh: 欧洲工作，我都会带上他们，那是世界上最好的教育。

sentences.en: with them, you know, and they meet people from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 和他们在一起，你知道，他们能见到来自世界各地的人。

sentences.en: Do you, you've got, how many kids have you got?
You've got a few daughters, is that right, Ray?
I've got grandsons as well, so, you know, it's kind of balanced itself out.
sentences.zh: 我还有外孙，所以，你知道，这算是平衡了。

sentences.en: I mean, I don't know about you guys, if you've got kids, you've got daughters.
sentences.zh: 我是说，不知道你们怎么样，如果你们有孩子，有女儿的话。

sentences.en: I've got three boys, Jason's got two girls.
sentences.zh: 我有三个儿子，杰森有两个女儿。

sentences.en: I can't, I'm looking forward to being a grandfather, because I was sort of, I'm looking forward
sentences.zh: 我等不及了，我很期待当爷爷，因为我一直，我很期待

sentences.en: Because the first time around, I was just like, yeah, well, it's great and everything.
sentences.zh: 因为第一次的时候，我只是觉得，嗯，挺好的，诸如此类。

sentences.en: You're just trying to get through it.
Yeah, but now in retrospect, I know how great it was once they started walking and talking
sentences.zh: 是啊，但现在回想起来，我知道当他们开始走路和说话时有多棒

sentences.en: was really kind of cool, like after like 12 months, but now I'm like, no, I bet you
sentences.zh: 那真的很酷，大概12个月之后，但现在我想，不，我敢打赌

sentences.en: there's something more in those 12 months that I need another crack at.
sentences.zh: 在那12个月里还有些东西是我需要再尝试一次的。

sentences.en: You know, the thing is when we were, when we had our kids, we were working.
sentences.zh: 你知道，问题在于我们当时，当我们有孩子的时候，我们都在工作。

sentences.en: And so it was, you know, we missed a lot of that.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们错过了很多。

sentences.en: Missed a lot of them kids.
sentences.zh: 错过了很多孩子们的成长时光。

sentences.en: And the thing about having a grandson, we can kind of sit back a little bit now.
sentences.zh: 而且有孙辈的好处是，我们现在可以稍微放松一下了。

sentences.en: You know, we've done what we've had to do.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们已经完成了该做的事。

sentences.en: And you've got time now with him.
sentences.zh: 而且你现在有时间陪他了。

sentences.en: So it's kind of saying, sorry, you know, in a way, but now I've got him.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一种补偿吧，你知道，某种程度上，但现在我有他了。

sentences.en: And when he gets on your nerves or she gets on your nerves, you can give her back.
sentences.zh: 当他或她让你心烦的时候，你可以把他还回去。
是啊，我爸就有这种想法。

sentences.en: I would say my dad had that philosophy when I was five.
sentences.zh: 我想说我爸在我五岁的时候就有这种哲学。

sentences.en: What are you doing there in Malta?
You said you've already done four weeks on it.
sentences.zh: 你说你已经在那里拍了四周了。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're doing a show called Danger Money for Amazon.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我们正在为亚马逊拍一部叫《危险金钱》的剧。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's about an old SAS guy.
sentences.zh: 是啊，讲的是一个退役特种空勤团成员的故事。

sentences.en: You know, in all these films where you've got men my age jumping out of bushes and karate
sentences.zh: 你知道，在所有这些电影里，你总能看到像我这个年纪的人从灌木丛里跳出来打空手道

sentences.en: chucking people and, you know, shooting everyone and kind of, I mean, they're fabulous to watch.
sentences.zh: 把人扔来扔去，你知道，到处开枪，我的意思是，看他们表演真是太棒了。

sentences.en: I love them, but we've kind of taken it the other way a bit.
sentences.zh: 我很喜欢，但我们有点走向了另一个极端。

sentences.en: I mean, he's an old boy who thinks, like Sean was saying, in his head he can still do it,
sentences.zh: 我是说，他是个老家伙，就像肖恩说的那样，他心里觉得他还能行，

sentences.en: And he can to a certain degree, but it hurts.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上他确实还能行，但会很疼。

sentences.en: You know, we suffer with rheumatism, you know, and we get shingles and things like that shit.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们会有风湿病，还有带状疱疹之类的鬼东西。

sentences.en: I've just got over shingles, you know.
sentences.zh: 我刚从带状疱疹里恢复过来，你知道吧。
天哪，这时间点真是绝了。

sentences.en: No, no, I was due to have it, but what happened with me was I stopped drinking about two and
sentences.zh: 没，没打，我本来该去打的，但当时的情况是，我大概在两年半前戒了酒，

sentences.en: And one day I just went, do you know what, I'm really fed up with this.
sentences.zh: 有一天我突然想，你知道吗，我真的受够了。
我再也享受不到喝酒的乐趣了。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm telling the same stories and talking to absolute bollocks I need just to have a
sentences.zh: 好吧，我一直在重复讲同样的故事，说着一堆废话，我需要从中

sentences.en: So I stopped drinking and I started training.
sentences.zh: 所以我戒了酒，开始锻炼。

sentences.en: Doing a bit of your stuff, Will, getting myself fit.
sentences.zh: 做点你那样的运动，威尔，让自己恢复健康。

sentences.en: Not running, but on a walking machine, you know.
sentences.zh: 不是跑步，是在跑步机上快走，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I got myself, I lost two and a half stone.
sentences.zh: 我成功减掉了两英石半（约16公斤）。

sentences.en: I felt fighting fit again for a couple of right-handers.
sentences.zh: 我又感觉自己能打两场硬仗了。

sentences.en: And then I got fucking shingles.
sentences.zh: 结果我就得了该死的带状疱疹。

sentences.en: By stopping drinking, looking after myself, stopped smoking, all the shit got rid of
sentences.zh: 通过戒酒、照顾好自己、戒烟，把生活中那些烂事都清理掉，

sentences.en: And then I fell ill with shingles.
sentences.zh: 然后我就得了带状疱疹。

sentences.en: Well, if you've ever had it, it's the worSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你得过这病，你就知道它有多糟糕了。
带状疱疹的症状是什么？

sentences.en: Well, you feel like you've got a red-hot poker being stuck through your back.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你会感觉就像有人拿根烧红的拨火棍捅进你的后背。

sentences.en: Yeah, but you get lesions come up.
sentences.zh: 是啊，而且还会长出水疱。

sentences.en: And my mother-in-law, mum, 94, said to me, Raymond, I had it once around the midriff.
sentences.zh: 我岳母，妈，94岁了，跟我说，雷蒙德，我以前腰部也长过一次。

sentences.en: She said, is it going all the way around your body?
sentences.zh: 她说，它是不是绕着你的身体长了一圈？

sentences.en: And I said, no, mum, it's not.
It's only halfway, you know, across the back.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这只蔓延到背部的一半。

sentences.en: What happens when it goes around, all the way around?
sentences.zh: 如果它绕过去，完全绕过去会怎样？

sentences.en: You get cream for the lesions and all that sort of stuff.
sentences.zh: 你可以涂些药膏来处理病灶之类的东西。

sentences.en: And how long did you have it?
It still creeps back on you.
Well, since November, it kind of settled down in February when I started working because you had other things to think about.
sentences.zh: 嗯，从十一月开始，二月份我开始工作时它稍微平复了一些，因为你有别的事情要操心。

sentences.en: But when I finished work, it came on again, started to know a job, it went away.
sentences.zh: 但当我结束工作时，它又复发了，开始找工作时，它又消失了。

sentences.en: And now I was just fed a bit in my back.
sentences.zh: 现在我背上又有点感觉了。

sentences.en: So it's been quite a while.
sentences.zh: 所以已经持续好一阵子了。

sentences.en: Maybe start drinking a little bit more, dude.
sentences.zh: 伙计，也许该多喝点酒了。

sentences.en: Maybe you need to pick up other things.
sentences.zh: 也许你需要找点别的事情做。

sentences.en: Well, I'm going out tonight for a meal, and I'm going to do a bottle of red wine.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我今晚要出去吃饭，打算喝一瓶红酒。

sentences.en: I mean, God, the cigs are tough to give up, aren't they, man?
sentences.zh: 我是说，天哪，烟真的很难戒，不是吗，伙计？

sentences.en: Do you know what I've done?
I got rid of the cigarettes.
Because all I do with that is I've got something to do with my hands, you know?
sentences.zh: 因为我抽烟只是为了让手上有事可做，你懂吗？

sentences.en: I'm not stealing anything when I got a cigarette in my hands.
sentences.zh: 手里拿着烟，我就不会去偷东西了。

sentences.en: But then I started smoking little cigars.
sentences.zh: 但后来我开始抽小雪茄了。

sentences.en: And the trouble with little cigars is you forget you're smoking a cigar and not a cigarette,
sentences.zh: 小雪茄的问题在于，你会忘了自己在抽雪茄而不是香烟，

sentences.en: and you take it down like a fucking cigarette.
sentences.zh: 然后像抽他妈的香烟一样猛吸。

sentences.en: And now, back to the show.
Ray, I wanted to get back into, we talked about in all this sort of fighting and boxing
sentences.zh: 雷，我想回到我们之前聊的话题，关于那些打斗、拳击之类的事，

sentences.en: and stuff, but you did legit, you started, you were boxing before you were acting.
sentences.zh: 但你确实是正儿八经练过的，你是在演戏之前就开始练拳击了。

sentences.en: And I'm interested how you made that, well, first of all, how the, I think your dad boxed
sentences.zh: 我很好奇你是怎么走上这条路的，首先，我想你父亲也练过一点拳击，

sentences.en: a little bit too, is that right?
Listen, where we came from, I'm sure it's the same in New York, you know, around the Bronx
sentences.zh: 听着，我们出身的地方，我相信纽约的布朗克斯区那边也一样，

sentences.en: and all that, as it is in Liverpool and Manchester and Coventry, you know, in England, and kids
sentences.zh: 就像英国的利物浦、曼彻斯特和考文垂一样，那种环境下的孩子，

sentences.en: from a certain manner, you know, I lived near the docks, so you kind of, your sport was boxing, you know.
sentences.zh: 我住在码头附近，所以拳击就是你的运动，你知道的。

sentences.en: Where, if you went to North London, it was probably more football, you know, and other sports, but, so we boxed.
sentences.zh: 如果你去北伦敦，可能更多是踢足球或其他运动，但我们就是练拳击的。

sentences.en: And I guess it was a way it goes back generational, because you've got to learn to survive, and you learn how to fight.
sentences.zh: 我想这是一种代代相传的方式，因为你必须学会生存，学会如何打架。

sentences.en: What boxing actually teaches you is how to avoid it, actually, because you get an instinct for it, you get an instinct
sentences.zh: 其实拳击真正教会你的是如何避免打架，因为你会产生一种本能，你会对

sentences.en: for where trouble's going to be, and you know how to conduct yourself, you know how to manoeuvre yourself
sentences.zh: 麻烦可能出现的地方产生直觉，你知道如何约束自己，知道如何让自己

sentences.en: away from those situations, you know.
sentences.zh: 避开那些情况，你知道的。

sentences.en: So, really, it was a great education in that way.
sentences.zh: 所以，从那方面来说，这确实是一种很好的教育。

sentences.en: Not only that, a boxing club, the great thing about boxing clubs is you get kids from all walks of life,
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，拳击俱乐部最棒的地方在于，你可以接触到各行各业的孩子，

sentences.en: you know, different religions, different colour, you know, different beliefs, but at a boxing club,
sentences.zh: 不同的宗教、不同的肤色、不同的信仰，但在拳击俱乐部里，

sentences.en: it's all forgotten about, it's just pushed away, and you kind of get the feeling, if the world was run like that,
sentences.zh: 这一切都被抛诸脑后，被推到一边，你会产生一种感觉，如果世界也是这样运作的，

sentences.en: we wouldn't have any problems, you know, because we didn't have any problems at boxing clubs, you know.
sentences.zh: 我们就不会有任何问题了，因为我们在拳击俱乐部里从来没出过问题。

sentences.en: So, then, so you're doing that, and then what's the thing that you go, what was the first,
sentences.zh: 所以，你当时在练拳击，然后是什么契机让你觉得，第一次，

sentences.en: what gave you that first sort of inclination to start performing, acting, like, what, was there one particular thing?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你产生了表演、演戏的念头？有没有什么特别的事情？

sentences.en: Well, I kind of done, I've done a school, I went into a school play when I was about, I guess I was about 14 years of age.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我大概在14岁左右参加过学校的戏剧演出。

sentences.en: There was a, there was a girl in the play that I kind of fancied, you know, she was, it's quite lovely.
sentences.zh: 剧里有个女孩，我当时挺喜欢的，她真的很可爱。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's always the way in it, boys, it's funny, you go into a certain thing, because you see someone and you think, oh, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，男孩子总是这样，挺有意思的，你会去做某件事，是因为你看到了某个人，然后心想，噢，你懂的。

sentences.en: I'd never thought about it before, I loved going to the cinema, loved watching films, you know,
sentences.zh: 我以前从没想过演戏，但我很喜欢去电影院，喜欢看电影，

sentences.en: I used to go with my dad every Wednesday, he'd come home from the market, and he'd pick me up, and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我过去每周三都跟我爸一起去，他从市场回来后会来接我，然后，

sentences.en: in the afternoon we'd go and watch a film, and always, you know, so, and I'd done this play called Emmy on the Detectives,
sentences.zh: 下午我们就去看电影，一直都是这样。后来我演了一部叫《艾米与侦探》的戏，

sentences.en: and I played the paper boy, you know, read all about it, and I got a few laughs, you know, and I think my mum and dad saw that,
sentences.zh: 我演那个卖报童，喊着“快来看报”，还引来了一些笑声，我想我爸妈看到了这一点，

sentences.en: because I was a bit of a kid on the streets, you know, and they thought, you know, it's got something here, this kid, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为我当时在街头混得有点野，他们觉得这孩子身上有点东西，

sentences.en: and they put me and paid for it when, you know, money was, it was 900 quid a term, and in those days, back in the 70s,
sentences.zh: 于是他们供我去学表演，当时学费是每学期900英镑，在70年代，

sentences.en: it was a lot of money, free terms a year, and my mum and dad were only working people, you know,
sentences.zh: 那可是一大笔钱，一年三个学期，我爸妈只是普通的工薪阶层，

sentences.en: and I think it was a way of keeping me off the streets, although I had the boxing club, which kind of done that,
sentences.zh: 我想这是一种让我远离街头的方式，尽管我有拳击俱乐部，也起到了同样的作用，

sentences.en: but to give me some, another outlook on life, in a way, because again, it was a place you met kids from all over the world,
sentences.zh: 但这给了我另一种看待生活的视角，因为那也是一个能让你遇见来自世界各地孩子的地方，

sentences.en: and, you know, it was a great education in that way, you know.
sentences.zh: 从那方面来说，这确实是一种很好的教育。

sentences.en: Did you have brothers or sisters that were running around doing something similar?
sentences.zh: 你有兄弟姐妹也在做类似的事情吗？

sentences.en: Sister Laura, she's my younger sister.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹劳拉，她是我的小妹妹。

sentences.en: She's probably more talented than I am, I would say so, but she never went into that, she's a mum, you know,
